title: Nudge mechanism allows owner to redirect 100% of claim revenue with no cap
justification: Privileged-role abuse beyond documented trust scope (same family as DEDUP-01 but framed as the standing systemic redirect rather than per-claim front-running). Owner can synchronously redirect all claim revenue to an EOA — no cap, no timelock, no beneficiary lock. Classified as Centralization because it requires owner malice/compromise and represents a privilege expansion not covered in the documented trust assumptions.
preconditions: Owner key compromise or malicious owner.
impact: All future claim revenue diverted permanently to attacker until governance intervention.
attack_path_summary: 1) Owner key compromise. 2) Attacker calls setNudgeAddress(attacker); setNudgeSplit(100). 3) All future claim revenue routes to attacker EOA.
centralization_framing: Mitigations (cap nudgeSplit, require nudge has code, timelock, pauser-callable emergency reset) reduce blast radius of owner compromise. Classified as Centralization in the C4 sense but flagged with strong framing because the power exceeds documented trust scope.
